title: Championship game
subtitle: 「冠軍賽／決賽／爭標戰」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定體育語境中很自然的替代表達？
description: 「冠軍賽／決賽／爭標戰」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定體育語境中很自然的替代表達？

words.note: 最直接、最常見的替代表達之一，指錦標賽最後一場決定冠軍的比賽。
words.example: They reached the final after winning the semifinal.
words.exampleZh: 他們贏得準決賽後晉身決賽。

exercises.original: They reached the championship game after winning the semifinal.
exercises.zh: 他們贏得準決賽後晉身決賽。
exercises.upgrade: They reached the final after winning the semifinal.

options.explanation: semifinal 之後決定冠軍的一場通常就是 final。
已經是原句中剛贏過的一輪，不可能再表示冠軍賽。
資格賽發生在更早階段。
可能只是淘汰賽其中一輪，未必是最後一場。
表演賽通常不決定冠軍。

exercises.original: Millions watched the championship game on television.
exercises.zh: 數百萬人透過電視觀看決賽。
exercises.upgrade: Millions watched the final on television.

options.explanation: 最簡潔自然地表示冠軍決賽。

exercises.original: The championship game will decide who wins the trophy.
exercises.zh: 決賽將決定誰贏得獎盃。
exercises.upgrade: The final will decide who wins the trophy.

options.explanation: 直接決定獎盃歸屬，最自然。

words.note: 和 championship game 很接近，尤其適合以 match 為常用名詞的運動。
words.example: The final match will be played on Sunday.

exercises.original: The championship game will be played on Sunday.
exercises.zh: 決賽將於星期日舉行。
exercises.upgrade: The final match will be played on Sunday.

options.explanation: 和 championship game 高度接近。

exercises.original: Both teams qualified for the championship game.
exercises.zh: 兩隊均晉身決賽。
exercises.upgrade: Both teams qualified for the final match.

options.explanation: qualified for + 最後決戰的語境自然。

exercises.original: The championship game ended 2–1 after extra time.
exercises.zh: 決賽加時後以 2 比 1 結束。
exercises.upgrade: The final match ended 2–1 after extra time.

options.explanation: 尤其適合 football 等常說 match 的運動。

words.note: 常見於北美體育語境，指決定冠軍頭銜的比賽。
words.example: The team advanced to the title game with a narrow victory.
words.exampleZh: 球隊以險勝晉身冠軍賽。

exercises.original: The team advanced to the championship game with a narrow victory.
exercises.zh: 球隊以險勝晉身冠軍賽。
exercises.upgrade: The team advanced to the title game with a narrow victory.

options.explanation: 北美體育語境中很自然，表示爭奪冠軍頭銜的一場。
是晉身 title game 前的一輪。

exercises.original: The championship game attracted a record crowd.
exercises.zh: 冠軍賽吸引破紀錄觀眾人數。
exercises.upgrade: The title game attracted a record crowd.

options.explanation: 直接表示決定 title 的比賽。

exercises.original: They lost the championship game by three points.
exercises.zh: 他們在冠軍賽以三分落敗。
exercises.upgrade: They lost the title game by three points.

options.explanation: 以 points 計分的北美運動語境尤其自然。

words.note: 和 championship game 高度接近，但 match 更適合某些運動。
words.example: The championship match drew a large television audience.
words.exampleZh: 這場冠軍賽吸引大量電視觀眾。

exercises.original: The championship game drew a large television audience.
exercises.zh: 冠軍賽吸引大量電視觀眾。
exercises.upgrade: The championship match drew a large television audience.

options.explanation: 和 championship game 高度接近，適合常用 match 的運動。

exercises.original: The two players met in the championship game.
exercises.zh: 兩名球員在冠軍賽交手。
exercises.upgrade: The two players met in the championship match.

options.explanation: 一對一運動中 match 比 game 更自然。

exercises.original: The championship game lasted nearly three hours.
exercises.zh: 冠軍賽持續接近三小時。
exercises.upgrade: The championship match lasted nearly three hours.

words.note: 較正式、描述性地表示某項 championship 的最後一場。
words.example: Both teams qualified for the championship final.
words.exampleZh: 兩隊均晉身錦標賽決賽。

exercises.original: Both clubs qualified for the championship game.
exercises.zh: 兩間球會均晉身錦標賽決賽。
exercises.upgrade: Both clubs qualified for the championship final.

options.explanation: 明確指出是 championship 的最後一場。

exercises.original: The championship game takes place at the national stadium.
exercises.zh: 錦標賽決賽在國家體育場舉行。
exercises.upgrade: The championship final takes place at the national stadium.

exercises.original: Tickets for the championship game sold out within an hour.
exercises.zh: 錦標賽決賽門票一小時內售罄。
exercises.upgrade: Tickets for the championship final sold out within an hour.

words.note: 表示為爭奪冠軍頭銜而進行的比賽。
words.example: The boxer won the title match by unanimous decision.
words.exampleZh: 拳手以一致判決贏得冠軍頭銜戰。

exercises.original: The boxer won the championship game by unanimous decision.
exercises.zh: 拳手以一致判決贏得冠軍頭銜戰。
exercises.upgrade: The boxer won the title match by unanimous decision.

options.explanation: 拳擊等運動中 title match 是非常自然的說法。
表演賽通常不爭正式頭銜。

exercises.original: The champion will defend the belt in the championship game.
exercises.zh: 冠軍將在頭銜戰中衛冕腰帶。
exercises.upgrade: The champion will defend the belt in the title match.

options.explanation: defend the belt 明確指爭奪／保衛冠軍頭銜。

exercises.original: The championship game will determine who holds the world title.
exercises.zh: 冠軍頭銜戰將決定誰取得世界冠軍。
exercises.upgrade: The title match will determine who holds the world title.

options.explanation: 直接決定 title 所有者。

words.note: 在澳洲、紐西蘭及部分英聯邦體育語境中特別常見。
words.example: The club reached the grand final for the first time in ten years.
words.exampleZh: 球會十年來首次晉身總決賽。

exercises.original: The club reached the championship game for the first time in ten years.
exercises.zh: 球會十年來首次晉身總決賽。
exercises.upgrade: The club reached the grand final for the first time in ten years.

options.explanation: 在澳洲／部分英聯邦體育語境中，是冠軍決賽的標準常用名稱。

exercises.original: More than 70,000 fans attended the championship game.
exercises.zh: 超過七萬名球迷入場觀看總決賽。
exercises.upgrade: More than 70,000 fans attended the grand final.

options.explanation: 大型聯賽終極決賽語境自然。

exercises.original: The championship game is the biggest event of the season.
exercises.zh: 總決賽是整個賽季最重要的賽事。
exercises.upgrade: The grand final is the biggest event of the season.

options.explanation: 在使用此術語的體育文化中，非常自然。

words.meaning: 決勝賽；決定冠軍的一場
words.note: 描述性地表示這場比賽會決定最終冠軍。
words.example: Everything comes down to the deciding game tomorrow.
words.exampleZh: 一切將在明天的決勝賽決定。

exercises.original: The championship game will decide the series.
exercises.zh: 這場決勝賽將決定系列賽冠軍。
exercises.upgrade: The deciding game will decide the series.

options.explanation: 直接表示這一場決定系列賽結果。

exercises.original: After six games, everything comes down to the championship game.
exercises.zh: 六場之後，一切都要在最後決勝賽決定。
exercises.upgrade: After six games, everything comes down to the deciding game.

options.explanation: 系列賽最後一場決勝戰很自然。

exercises.original: Tomorrow's championship game will determine the league winner.
exercises.zh: 明天的決勝賽將決定聯賽冠軍。
exercises.upgrade: Tomorrow's deciding game will determine the league winner.

options.explanation: 只要這一場真正決定冠軍，這個描述就很自然。

words.meaning: 爭標決勝戰；冠軍決定戰
words.note: 體育新聞和評論中很自然，表示直接決定冠軍歸屬的比賽。
words.example: The two rivals will meet in a title decider on the final day.
words.exampleZh: 兩支宿敵將在最後一天進行冠軍決定戰。

exercises.original: The two rivals meet in a championship game on the final day of the season.
exercises.zh: 兩支宿敵在賽季最後一天進行冠軍決定戰。
exercises.upgrade: The two rivals meet in a title decider on the final day of the season.

options.explanation: 體育新聞中很自然，尤其直接決定聯賽冠軍時。

exercises.original: Sunday's championship game could determine who finishes first.
exercises.zh: 星期日的爭標決勝戰可能決定誰排名第一。
exercises.upgrade: Sunday's title decider could determine who finishes first.

exercises.original: The season ends with a championship game between the top two teams.
exercises.zh: 賽季以頭兩名球隊之間的冠軍決定戰作結。
exercises.upgrade: The season ends with a title decider between the top two teams.

options.explanation: 最終排名第一的直接對決，很自然。

words.note: 較有戲劇性、新聞化的常見表達，指冠軍爭奪中的最後對決。
words.example: The season ends with a final showdown between the two strongest teams.
words.exampleZh: 賽季以兩支最強球隊的終極對決作結。

exercises.original: The championship game brings together the two strongest teams.
exercises.zh: 冠軍賽是兩支最強球隊的終極對決。
exercises.upgrade: The final showdown brings together the two strongest teams.

options.explanation: 生動地表示最後、最重要的一場對決。

exercises.original: Fans have waited all season for the championship game.
exercises.zh: 球迷整季都在等待這場終極對決。
exercises.upgrade: Fans have waited all season for the final showdown.

options.explanation: 體育評論中有很強的戲劇性和終極感。

exercises.original: The tournament ends with a championship game between the defending champion and the top seed.
exercises.zh: 錦標賽以衛冕冠軍和頭號種子的終極對決作結。
exercises.upgrade: The tournament ends with a final showdown between the defending champion and the top seed.

options.explanation: 最後一戰＋兩大強者，最適合此新聞化表達。

falseSynonyms.zh: 準決賽不等於冠軍賽 semifinal 的勝方才晉身 final。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They won the semifinal. They then played in the championship game.

falseSynonyms.zh: 季後賽／附加賽不一定是冠軍賽 playoffs 可以包括多輪；championship game 通常是最後決定冠軍的一場。
資格賽不等於決賽 qualifier 的功能是爭取晉級資格。
淘汰賽不一定是冠軍賽 elimination game 只表示輸家可能出局，不一定直接決定冠軍。
整個錦標賽不等於最後一場 tournament 包含多場比賽； championship game 是其中最後決定冠軍的一場。
錦標／冠軍賽事不一定等於一場比賽 championship 可以指整項賽事、冠軍頭銜或冠軍身份。
最後一輪不一定是一場 championship game 高爾夫等運動的 final round 是最後一輪比賽，但不一定是一場單獨的冠軍賽。
拼字相近但用法不同 - final = 決賽／最後的 - finale = 節目、表演或系列的高潮結尾 體育冠軍賽通常不用 finale。
